name: MCIPCE1
tagline: Intel Core i7-1360P industrial PC with four LAN ports and 9–36V input
description: MCIPCE1 combines an Intel Core i7-1360P, up to 32GB DDR4, two Gigabit and two 2.5GbE ports, six serial ports, and 14 GPIO signals. Four serial ports support RS-485/RS-422. A 9–36V Phoenix terminal input, multiple storage interfaces, and desktop or wall mounting support custom industrial deployments.

specifications.label: Memory
specifications.value: 2 x DDR4 SO-DIMM, up to 32 GB

specifications.label: Network
specifications.value: 2 x Intel GbE; 2 x Intel 2.5 GbE

specifications.label: Serial
specifications.value: 6 x RS-232 COM; 4 ports support RS-485/RS-422

specifications.label: Other I/O
specifications.value: 1 x PS/2; 1 x headphone; 1 x microphone; 2 x antenna ports

specifications.label: Buttons
specifications.value: 1 x Power; 1 x Reset; 1 x Clear CMOS; 1 x ATX/AT selector

specifications.label: Storage
specifications.value: 1 x mSATA; 1 x M.2 NVMe 2280; 1 x HDD/SSD bay

specifications.label: Expansion
specifications.value: 1 x half-size Mini PCIe; 1 x full-size Mini PCIe with SIM; Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/3G/4G support

specifications.label: Environment - Storage
specifications.value: -30 to 70 C; 10%-90% RH at 30 C, non-condensing
